health.detail: dsh-superagent ready; the Superagent sidebar entry opens the management panel

description.zh: 智能体的 GitHub 账号；接收仓库里发给它的通知、已订阅 Issue 与 PR 的讨论、CI 状态变化和 PR 合并关闭。
description.en: The agent's GitHub accounts; receives notifications to it in the repository, discussion on subscribed Issues and PRs, CI changes, and PR merge or close.

hint.zh: 留空使用 github.com；自建 GitHub Enterprise 填站点根地址，例如 https://github.example.com。
hint.en: Leave empty for github.com; for a self-hosted GitHub Enterprise, enter the site root such as https://github.example.com.

hint.zh: 写作 owner/name。这个来源接收这个仓库的通知和讨论；保存时检查智能体账号能否推送到它，然后重启 dsh-superagent。
hint.en: Written owner/name. This Source receives the repository's notifications and discussion; saving checks that the agent account can push to it, then restarts dsh-superagent.

hint.zh: 命令名或绝对路径，通常是用 GH_CONFIG_DIR 登录智能体账号的 gh 包装脚本。智能体以它登录的账号行事，执行器以 gh 调用它。保存时检查它登录的账号能否推送到仓库，然后重启 dsh-superagent。
hint.en: A command name or absolute path, usually a gh wrapper signed in to the agent account through GH_CONFIG_DIR. The agent acts as the account it is signed in to, and the Executor calls it as gh. Saving checks that this account can push to the repository, then restarts dsh-superagent.

hint.zh: GitHub 要求更长间隔时以 GitHub 为准。
hint.en: A longer interval requested by GitHub wins.

label.zh: 连续失败几次后报告异常
label.en: Failed polls before reporting an error

hint.zh: 单次网络中断会在下一次轮询时自动重试，不必报告。
hint.en: A single network interruption is retried on the next poll and need not be reported.

label.en: Receive new Issues in the repository

hint.zh: 打开后，没有 @ 智能体的新 Issue 也会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。从打开的时候开始，不读以前的。
hint.en: New Issues that do not mention the agent are received too, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates. Starts when switched on; earlier ones are not read.

label.en: Receive new pull requests in the repository

hint.zh: 打开后，没有 @ 智能体的新 PR 也会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。
hint.en: New pull requests that do not mention the agent are received too, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates.

hint.zh: 打开后，Issue 和 PR 上没有 @ 智能体的评论和代码评论也会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。
hint.en: Comments and review comments on Issues and PRs that do not mention the agent are received too, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates.

hint.zh: 打开后，默认分支的 CI 失败和恢复会收到，由策略的接收表决定是否成为候选。
hint.en: Failures of the default branch's CI, and its recovery, are received, and the Policy's admission table decides whether they become candidates.

label.zh: 能发起工作的 GitHub 账号
label.en: GitHub accounts that may originate work

label.zh: 评论可以成为候选的机器人
label.en: Bots whose comments may become candidates

hint.zh: 名单里的机器人账号（例如 dependabot[bot]）的评论在来源收到时成为推断的候选，交给评估：评论 @ 了智能体，或者打开了“接收仓库里的评论”。它们不能发起明确的请求，也不能停止工单；其他机器人的评论不接收。
hint.en: A comment of a bot account on this list, such as dependabot[bot], becomes an inferred candidate for an assessment when the Source receives it: when it mentions the agent, or with Receive comments in the repository on. Such a comment never makes an explicit request or stops a ticket; other bots' comments are not admitted.

explicit.zh: 名单里的账号在 Issue 或评论里 @ 智能体的账号。
explicit.en: An account on the list mentions the agent's account in an Issue or a comment.
